archetypes.name: dyn-timing-schema-compat
archetypes.rationale: Schema change repurposes a reserved timing-ledger column; verify no v1 round-row consumer regresses on legacy or new rows
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the timing-ledger schema change in python/timing.py and python/progress_report.py. The fix repurposes the reserved trailing column (index 12) of v1 round rows as a 1-based attempt index. Verify this does not break any consumer: the strict 13-column guard in timing._parse_rows, the dedup matcher review_and_fix._timing_row_matches (which keys on cols 1/3/4/5/6/7), the design plan_review round reader, and the prior-round-end and latest-ts readers in progress_report. Confirm attempt defaults to 1 for legacy rows that still carry '-' and that _render_phase_gantt's per-attempt grouping stays correct when a round reruns in the same session. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
